'''Amy Birnbaum''' is an American voice actress who worked for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. 

==Biography==
Birnbaum was one of the original voice actors on Pokémon. She mostly played [[Character of the day|characters of the day]] until {{aniseries|RS}}, when she was cast as [[Max]]. She voiced the character until the end of [[S08|the eighth season]] when [[4Kids Entertainment]] [[Pokémon USA recasting controversy|gave up the dubbing and distribution of the series]] to {{TPCi|Pokémon USA}} and [[TAJ Productions]]. [[Kayzie Rogers]] took over the role of Max, and Birnbaum has not returned to voice any characters on the show since.
